title: VKS OldLiteraryFinnish
notes: Corpus of Old Literary Finnish (Vanhan kirjasuomen korpus, VKS) of Kotus, the Institute for the Languages of Finland, distributed through the Language Bank of Finland (Kielipankki) and its Korp search interface. It holds written Finnish texts from 1543 to 1810, among them Bible translations and religious texts (all of Mikael Agricola's Finnish works), legal texts, poems and texts on agriculture, nature and health. It was compiled for lexicographic use and is browsable and searchable on the web; the resource is listed as publicly available. The Kielipankki page was last modified on 2025-11-26. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Kotus (Institute for the Languages of Finland), via Kielipankki (Language Bank of Finland)
